music.attribution: Waiting by the Stump — Galanty, original score generated with Google Lyria and edited with code-synthesized sound design (CC0 1.0)
music.modifications: Generated with Google Lyria (lyria-3.5) from an original timeline prompt; edited by tools/production/shouzhu-20261013/music_build.py (re-timed to the film, 230 Hz dip, NumPy-synthesized SFX: bonk, star twinkles, rooster, wind and rain beds, page flips, pops, woodblock steps, snores, chimes; no third-party samples), then encoded to 48 kbps MP3, 48 kHz stereo (library size budget). Timed to sample S113; other films will not hit its accents.

note: 给 4～9 岁小朋友的寓言动画。旁白为预先生成的 Gemini 云端配音（旁白 Leda、农夫台词 Achird，随包旁白种子，播放不联网）；改旁白文字后新句需要本机配音整片重配。13 幕共用一个幕代码模块 sz-tale（props.shot 选镜头），底图与角色贴纸（AI 生成、绿幕抠图）以 data URI 只内联一份。配乐 Waiting by the Stump（CC0，随包曲库 library:original-waiting-stump）按本片逐字时间轴卡点并合成音效：改节奏或换曲后音效不再对齐。天气参数在 weather 幕的 weathers，天数在 monthDay、lastDay。正文约 100 秒，导出时接约 4.9 秒品牌片尾
